newsitem.title: POLAND: Final decision on Polish KGHM sale in 14 days -PM.
newsitem.headline: Final decision on Polish KGHM sale in 14 days -PM.

text.p: The Polish government will make a final decision on the privatisation of the giant copper combine KGHM Polska Miedz SA within two weeks, Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz said on Thursday.
"During the next two weeks, the cabinet will make a final and binding decision on the sale of KGHM, one of the biggest Polish firms," Cimoszewicz told Reuters in an interview.
"The scenario of this privatisation envisages that after the decision KGHM shares would be introduced to bourses in London and Warsaw in a not too distant future," he added. @

Senior privatisation officials have earlier said that the government decision would concern the size of the treasury stake retained after the sell-off, which bourses KGHM shares would be listed on and other details.
Cimoszewicz confirmed that part of KGHM shares would be earmarked to help finance Poland's crucial reform of the social security system.
Under a preliminary plan, the government would issue bonds convertible into shares of companies undergoing privatisation to finance the creation of new, independent pension funds. @
Cimoszewicz said that until the conversion the treasury could hand over its KGHM stake to an independent institution for management.
Earlier the treasury ministry had signalled it wanted to float 15 percent of KGHM in London and another 10 percent of shares on the Warsaw bourse.
